title: Heart line symbolism
tradition: Traditionally associated with emotion and connection. It cannot establish real feelings or relationship outcomes.
source: PALMA project editorial knowledge note; not scientific predictive evidence

title: Head line symbolism
tradition: Used as a symbol of thought and imagination; palm creases do not measure intelligence or mental health.

title: Life line symbolism
tradition: Traditionally associated with vitality and life experience. Its length does not measure lifespan or diagnose health.

title: Fate line symbolism
tradition: Sometimes symbolizes direction and purpose. It does not determine careers, wealth, or destiny.

title: Prosperity symbolism
tradition: Prosperity is a cultural narrative theme. Palm features cannot establish finances or predict earnings.

title: Image processing
tradition: OpenCV converts to grayscale, smooths with a Gaussian kernel, enhances local contrast with CLAHE, finds Canny edges, applies Otsu thresholding, and performs morphological closing. Edges and geometric segments are not validated palmistry lines.
source: PALMA project editorial knowledge note; not scientific predictive evidence

title: Visual comparison
tradition: Compare brightness, contrast, sharpness and candidate counts as image measurements. Lighting and orientation can change these values; they do not establish personality differences.
source: PALMA project editorial knowledge note; not scientific predictive evidence

title: Limits and privacy
tradition: Palmistry is cultural entertainment, not a validated prediction method. This project does not establish health, lifespan, wealth, relationships or future outcomes. Raw images are processed without permanent storage; optional AI receives structured features and chat text only.
source: PALMA project editorial knowledge note; not scientific predictive evidence
